Description: ElastiCache Replication Group found without automatic failover enabled. When this is enabled, in case the primary node fails, the role will automatically failover to a read replica.
Risk: Without automatic failover, there may be availability issues in the event of an outage. Manual recovery would be required, and may result in lost writes.

Recommendation.Text: Automatic Failover should be enabled for replication groups with a minimum of 1 (one) replica per shard, to minimize downtime.
